verdict: ACCEPT: no concrete source defect found in the seven frozen v1 payload files or their current-parent dependency composition.
review_kind: Independent source and hash review only; no new tests, browser execution, build, source edit, or GitHub mutation.
manifest_provenance: The frozen manifest names the original authoring base and an older candidate pathname. This review reads the seven matching files from the explicit /dev/shm candidate path. The separately saved publication-parent.json identifies current composition parent 8e50105f.

basis: scope-draft-file.mjs: copyDraft validates and copies exact string values without trimming, amount parsing, coercion, sorting or review validation. It reconstructs detached draft/row objects and preserves dense checkpoint order.
serializeScopeDraft fixes only the versioned JSON envelope and formatting; parseScopeDraftFile returns the exact editable fields. Unfinished amounts, blanks, whitespace and Unicode remain strings.
scope-workspace.mjs readDraft reads actual native field values; replaceDraft writes those values directly. Preview-only label trimming and display fallbacks do not mutate pending.draft.

CR/LF restrictions match the supported native fields: LF is accepted in brief/evidence; CR and single-line input newlines are refused before replacement. This avoids accepting values the form would normalize.
Actual file.size is checked against 1 MiB before arrayBuffer(); fatal UTF-8 decoding precedes JSON parsing; the parser separately counts encoded bytes.
Exact own-key sets are enforced for the envelope, draft and each checkpoint. The envelope requires schema scopesignal.scope-draft, version 1 and fixtureOnly true; all editable values must be strings.
Dense arrays are constrained to 1 through MAX_CHECKPOINTS (12). Sparse lists, extra properties, unsupported fields and own accessors are refused.
Required text, field lengths, valid positive USD and project-cap checks remain in validateScopeDraft at review time; unfinished drafts are intentionally saveable.
The file allowlist has no approval, accepted-decision, ledger-event, ID or capture fields; extra fields are rejected rather than ignored.
File handlers require review === null and a visible draft form. The existing edit action refuses any review whose event list is nonempty.

Opening does not create or modify a ledger. Review submission invalidates the file request and calls createScopeReview, which creates a fresh ledger with an empty event list and unapproved checkpoints.
Unapproved review evidence may return as editable planned text through the existing Edit draft path; it cannot carry a recorded approval.
Each open request captures selection, revision and JSON.stringify(readDraft()). current() checks all three plus editing state.
Selection increments on reset and actual read initiation. Superseded asynchronous resolutions and rejections return without replacing the form or status.
Input edits, checkpoint additions/removals, review entry and return to editing invalidate intent and pending data. A value snapshot also detects programmatic field changes without an input event.
Replace repeats current(pending.request), so a stale preview cannot overwrite intervening changes even after a successful parse.

findings.area: Atomic application at the product boundary
basis: Read, UTF-8 decode, JSON parse and complete structural validation finish before a pending draft is exposed.
Preview writes only preview elements. The current authored form remains untouched until an explicit Replace this draft click with a still-current request.
Replacement then runs synchronously using the fully validated dense, bounded draft; no asynchronous operation interrupts the form update.

Cancel, invalid/unreadable/oversized inputs and stale reads do not call replaceDraft. The atomicity claim concerns these application paths, not exceptional platform failures such as out-of-memory or externally removed DOM nodes.

findings.area: Literal DOM and local data handling
basis: File names, field previews, summaries, checkpoint rows, statuses and reviewed values use textContent; editable fields use .value.
No file-derived HTML, selector, script, URL or executable markup is constructed. The only download href is an application-created Blob URL with a constant filename.
The added modules contain no fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, browser-storage or payment calls. Download links are removed and Blob URLs are revoked on a later task.
Save/Open/Replace/Cancel controls have type=button; status and preview focus targets are present in scope.html.

findings.area: Publication scope and existing test evidence
basis: All seven file byte lengths, SHA256 values and independently computed Git blob IDs match candidate-frozen-v1.json.
